visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Number Pairs with Itself
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For [3, 2, 4] and target 6 the answer is [1, 2] (2 + 4), but the program prints [0, 0].

solution.explanation: The current number must be looked up before it is stored. Storing first lets 3 find itself as its own complement (3 + 3 = 6), but an element may not be used twice.
